title: Nvidia Investigates CEO Jensen Huang Over Affair
excerpt: Nvidia launched an investigation into CEO Jensen Huang following an acknowledged affair with an AI executive and Chinese government agent.
body_html:
Nvidia has initiated an investigation regarding CEO Jensen Huang and his relationship with Alice Huang, who is identified as an AI executive and an agent of the Chinese government.

Alongside the announcement from the company's Board of Directors about the ongoing probe, Jensen Huang distributed a memo to Nvidia employees in which he acknowledged the affair.

The company disclosed the investigation on Sunday, prompting the release of the internal communication to staff.
